/** pcaSql - selectReview - 전분기 과제목표 조회 */ SELECT VESTICODE as "vEstiCode" /* 평가코드 */ , VPROJECTGOAL as "vProjectGoal" /* 과제목표 */ , VPROJECTMILESTONE as "vProjectMileStone" /* 평가 기간내 Milestone */ FROM ( SELECT VESTICODE , VPROJECTGOAL , VPROJECTMILESTONE FROM TCA4003
VPROJECTCODE = #{vProjectCode} AND VESTICODE NOT IN (#{vEstiCode})
ORDER BY VESTICODE DESC )
ROWNUM = 1

/** pcaSql - selectContributionSum - 기여도 합 조회 */ SELECT NVL(SUM(a.NCONTRIBUTION), 0) as "nContribution" FROM TCA4005 A, TCA4002 B
A.VESTICODE = B.VESTICODE AND A.VEMPLNO = B.VEMPLNO AND A.VESTICODE = #{vEstiCode} AND A.VPROJECTCODE = #{vProjectCode} AND B.VESTIYN = 'Y'

/** pcaSql - selectWrmDataList - 주간업무입력 데이터 조회 */ SELECT A.VWEEK as "vWeek" , A.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" , A.VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" , A.NSEQNO as "nSeqNo" , A.VWORKCONTENT as "vWorkContent" , B."vFileNames" as "vFileNames" FROM TWR4003 A, ( SELECT VWEEK, NSEQNO, LISTAGG(VFILENAME || '->' || NFILESEQNO, '|') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY VFILENAME) as "vFileNames" FROM TWR4004
AND VEMPLNO = #{vEmplNo} AND (VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek1} || '%' OR VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek2} || '%' OR VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek3} || '%')
GROUP BY VWEEK, NSEQNO ) B
AND A.VPROJECTCODE = #{vProjectCode} AND A.VEMPLNO = #{vEmplNo} AND A.VWORKTYPE = '1' /* 실적 */ AND A.VJOBTYPE = '2' /* 과제수행 */ AND (A.VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek1} || '%' OR A.VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek2} || '%' OR A.VWEEK LIKE #{vWeek3} || '%') AND A.VWEEK = B.VWEEK(+) AND A.NSEQNO = B.NSEQNO(+)
ORDER BY A.VWEEK ASC

/** pcaSql - selectFileInfo - 산출물 파일 정보 조회 */ SELECT VWEEK as "vWeek" , VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" , NSEQNO as "nSeqNo" , NFILESEQNO as "nFileSeqNo" , VFILENAME as "vFileName" , VTEMPFILENAME as "vTempFileName" , VFILEPATH as "vFilePath" , VFILEEXTENSION as "vFileExtension" FROM TWR4004
AND VWEEK = #{vWeek} AND VEMPLNO = #{vEmplNo} AND VWORKTYPE = '1' AND NSEQNO = #{nSeqNo} AND NFILESEQNO = #{nFileSeqNo}

/** pcaSql - selectDeptNameList - 부서 조회 */ SELECT VTEAMNAME as "vDeptName" FROM TAZ2001 WHERE VUSEYN = 'Y' AND VTEAMFLAG IN ('1', '2') AND VTEAMCODE NOT IN ('AB000', 'EA000', 'EC000', 'ED000') ORDER BY VDISPLAYORDER ASC
